comment: Cascade order with the animation layers (CSS Cascade 4): an animation beats normal declarations and loses to important ones (#imp keeps its width, its colour animates; #byid: an important class rule beats the id rule and the animation; #inline: an important inline width); a transition beats important declarations (#trans goes from one important width to another); an important class colour beats a more specific id rule (#text). Captured at 0.5 s and 1.5 s of the animation, the transition half way.
